schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) - { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: A4 (Content Factory)
definition: Fourteenth-wave candidate Vietnamese-L1 interference items for human review before promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS. Focus areas: comparative calques, copula-drop, serial verb chains, question word order, resumptive pronouns, adjective order, register mismatches, body-action collocations, verb-preposition collocation errors, reflect/remember/borrow/say-tell-discuss-exercise-participate false friends, stative progressive errors, did-not+past-form errors, present perfect omission, and uncountable/article errors.
dedupedAgainst: A4 local check against live VIETLISH_CORPUS + pending waves 1-13, case-insensitive vietlish matching (2,945 exclusions).

entries.sourcePattern: mưa lớn -> Vietnamese uses big/small for rain intensity; English uses heavy/light
entries.context: I will stay home because there is big rain outside today.

entries.sourcePattern: mưa nhỏ -> small calqued from nhỏ; English uses light for low-intensity rain
entries.context: Bring a light jacket, small rain is falling outside right now.

entries.natural: it is sunny and hot today
entries.sourcePattern: nắng nóng -> hot sun as a noun-phrase calque from the Vietnamese compound
entries.context: Wear sunscreen because hot sun today and UV levels are very high.

entries.sourcePattern: trời khóc -> poetic Vietnamese expression calqued directly into English
entries.context: Bring an umbrella because the sky is crying outside.

entries.natural: there is a cold wind blowing
entries.sourcePattern: gió lạnh -> serial verb structure calqued; wind blow cold compresses a full VP
entries.context: Close the window because wind blow cold and I feel uncomfortable.

entries.sourcePattern: mắt cảm thấy buồn ngủ -> body-part as grammatical subject with dropped possessive
entries.context: I cannot focus on studying because the eyes feel sleepy.

entries.sourcePattern: chân cảm thấy mệt -> chân (leg/foot) as subject, possessive dropped
entries.context: After walking all day, the legs feel tired and sore.

entries.sourcePattern: cảm thấy bụng đói -> stomach as explicit object of feel, calqued from Vietnamese body-organ focus
entries.context: It is already noon and I feel the stomach hungry.

entries.sourcePattern: tay không với tới -> hand as subject with negation, body-part ownership calque
entries.context: Can you help me grab that box? My hand not reach the top shelf.

entries.sourcePattern: mũi ngửi thấy mùi gì -> nose as agent subject calqued from Vietnamese
entries.context: Wait, the nose smell something burning in the kitchen.

entries.sourcePattern: con đường này dài hơn -> more + adj instead of adj+er; hơn becomes more
entries.context: Take the other route because this road more long and wastes your time.

entries.vietlish: price here more cheap than city center
entries.natural: prices here are cheaper than in the city center
entries.sourcePattern: giá ở đây rẻ hơn trung tâm -> more cheap instead of cheaper; comparative marker hơn becomes more
entries.context: Shop in this district because price here more cheap than city center.

entries.vietlish: this bag more heavy than that one
entries.natural: this bag is heavier than that one
entries.sourcePattern: túi này nặng hơn túi kia -> more heavy instead of heavier; hơn becomes more for all comparatives
entries.context: I will carry the small one because this bag more heavy than that one.

entries.sourcePattern: tiếng Anh của tôi tốt hơn bây giờ -> more better as double comparative; hơn produces more
entries.context: After six months of practice, my english more better now.

entries.vietlish: the coffee less sweet than yesterday
entries.natural: the coffee is less sweet than yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: cà phê ít ngọt hơn hôm qua -> less sweet as calque of ít ngọt; copula dropped
entries.context: Did they change the recipe? The coffee less sweet than yesterday.

entries.vietlish: the new model more thin and light
entries.natural: the new model is thinner and lighter
entries.sourcePattern: model mới mỏng và nhẹ hơn -> more + adj for multi-attribute comparative
entries.context: I am upgrading my phone because the new model more thin and light.

entries.vietlish: this version more stable than before
entries.natural: this version is more stable than the previous one
entries.sourcePattern: phiên bản này ổn định hơn -> copula dropped in comparative clause
entries.context: Update your app because this version more stable than before.

entries.sourcePattern: bộ phim hay -> SAdj predicate without copula calqued from Vietnamese
entries.context: You should watch it tonight, the movie interesting and very funny.

entries.sourcePattern: đồ ăn ở đây ngon -> copula omission with place modifier; Vietnamese SAdj pattern
entries.context: I love coming to this restaurant because food here delicious.

entries.sourcePattern: người ở đây thân thiện -> copula omission with plural subject + place modifier
entries.context: I enjoy living in this neighborhood because people here friendly.

entries.natural: the problem is not a big deal
entries.sourcePattern: vấn đề không lớn -> copula dropped in negated adjectival predicate
entries.context: Do not panic, problem not big and we can fix it today.

entries.sourcePattern: phòng sạch rồi -> already placed sentence-finally instead of before adjective
entries.context: You do not need to clean, the room is clean already.

entries.vietlish: go eat lunch then come back
entries.natural: I will get lunch and be back soon
entries.sourcePattern: đi ăn trưa rồi về -> serial verb chain calqued: go + eat + then + come back
entries.context: Give me thirty minutes, go eat lunch then come back.

entries.sourcePattern: tắm rồi ra ngoài -> take bath as calque of tắm; serial chain with no conjunction
entries.context: You should take bath go out so you feel fresh for the date.

entries.natural: bring the child along to the market
entries.sourcePattern: bế con đi chợ -> carry child is literal calque of bế (hold/carry a child)
entries.context: I need to carry child go market today since there is no babysitter.

entries.natural: once you finish eating you can leave
entries.sourcePattern: ăn xong có thể đi -> serial completion chain calqued without conjunction
entries.context: No need to rush, finish eat can go whenever you are ready.

entries.sourcePattern: mặc quần áo vào -> put clothes wear as compound calque of the Vietnamese verb phrase
entries.context: Wake up quickly and put clothes wear so we can leave on time.

entries.natural: what did you come here for
entries.sourcePattern: đến đây làm gì -> come here for what as direct calque of purpose question
entries.context: You surprised me at the office, come here for what?

entries.natural: what are you going there to buy
entries.sourcePattern: đến đó mua gì -> purpose question with wh-word at end
entries.context: I saw you at the mall, go there to buy what?

entries.vietlish: he speak like that means he angry
entries.natural: the way he speaks suggests he is angry
entries.sourcePattern: nói vậy là giận -> reasoning chain calque: event + means + state
entries.context: Be careful, he speak like that means he angry.

entries.sourcePattern: học tiếng Anh khó -> bare infinitive used as subject; gerund form and copula dropped
entries.context: I admire you because learn english difficult for most people.

entries.sourcePattern: điện bị cắt -> passive calque; cắt (cut) used for power outage as in Vietnamese idiom
entries.context: I could not charge my phone last night because electric is cut.

entries.sourcePattern: nước bị cắt -> passive calque; cắt (cut) used for water disruption as in Vietnamese idiom
entries.context: I could not shower this morning because water is cut in our building.

entries.sourcePattern: về nhà sớm tối nay -> turn back as calque of quay về (turn/return home)
entries.context: I need to turn back home early tonight to prepare for my trip tomorrow.

entries.natural: speaking Vietnamese is easy for me
entries.sourcePattern: nói tiếng Việt dễ với tôi -> bare infinitive as topic subject, copula dropped
entries.context: I grew up in Hanoi so speak vietnamese easy for me.

entries.sourcePattern: bạn đã ăn chưa -> no subject-auxiliary inversion for yes/no question
entries.context: It is almost one o'clock. You have already eaten?

entries.sourcePattern: bạn thích đồ cay -> no do-support in yes/no question
entries.context: We are ordering Thai food tonight. You like spicy food?

entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy có thể nói tiếng Anh -> no modal-subject inversion in question
entries.context: He will be our guide. He can speak english?

entries.sourcePattern: bạn đang đi đâu -> wh-word at sentence end, no inversion
entries.context: Wait! You are going where with those bags?

entries.sourcePattern: bạn muốn gì -> wh-word at sentence end, no do-support
entries.context: I am at the store. Text me and tell me, you want what?

entries.sourcePattern: bạn bao nhiêu tuổi -> no subject-auxiliary inversion with how-old question
entries.context: I forgot to ask earlier, how old you are?

entries.natural: what time do you wake up
entries.sourcePattern: mấy giờ bạn thức dậy -> wh-phrase front but no do-support added
entries.context: You look tired. What time you wake up this morning?

entries.vietlish: why you do not answer my message
entries.natural: why did you not answer my message
entries.sourcePattern: sao bạn không trả lời tin nhắn -> no auxiliary inversion after why
entries.context: I was worried about you. Why you do not answer my message?

entries.natural: where did you go last weekend
entries.sourcePattern: bạn đã đi đâu cuối tuần trước -> no do-support or past tense inversion
entries.context: I did not see you online. Where you went last weekend?

entries.vietlish: how long you have been learning english
entries.natural: how long have you been learning English
entries.sourcePattern: bạn học tiếng Anh bao lâu rồi -> no auxiliary-subject inversion in how-long question
entries.context: Your pronunciation is great. How long you have been learning english?

entries.sourcePattern: bao giờ bạn rảnh -> no will-subject inversion in when question
entries.context: I want to hang out. When you will be free this week?

entries.natural: who did you talk to yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: bạn đã nói chuyện với ai hôm qua -> wh-word at end, no inversion
entries.context: You seemed very happy after work. Who you talked to yesterday?

entries.vietlish: which bus you take to work
entries.natural: which bus do you take to work
entries.sourcePattern: bạn đi xe buýt số mấy đi làm -> wh-phrase front, no do-support
entries.context: I want to commute with you. Which bus you take to work?

entries.sourcePattern: cái này bao nhiêu tiền -> wh-phrase front, no do-support
entries.context: Can you tell me, how much this cost?

entries.sourcePattern: tại sao cái này đắt vậy -> no subject-copula inversion after why
entries.context: I cannot afford it. Why this is so expensive?

entries.vietlish: the friend who i told you about him is funny
entries.natural: the friend I told you about is very funny
entries.sourcePattern: người bạn tôi kể về anh ấy -> resumptive pronoun him retained after relative clause
entries.context: You will love meeting him. The friend who i told you about him is funny.

entries.vietlish: the house which i rented it last year
entries.natural: the house that I rented last year
entries.sourcePattern: cái nhà mà tôi thuê nó năm ngoái -> resumptive pronoun it in relative clause
entries.context: The house which i rented it last year was in District 3.

entries.vietlish: the bag i bought yesterday it is very nice
entries.natural: the bag I bought yesterday is very nice
entries.sourcePattern: cái túi tôi mua hôm qua nó rất đẹp -> resumptive pronoun it after relative clause
entries.context: I am so happy because the bag i bought yesterday it is very nice.

entries.vietlish: i have a sister name linh
entries.natural: I have a sister named Linh
entries.sourcePattern: tôi có một người chị tên Linh -> name used as noun, past participle named omitted
entries.context: I have a sister name linh who lives in Saigon.

entries.vietlish: this is the shop sell fresh bread
entries.natural: this is the shop that sells fresh bread
entries.sourcePattern: đây là cửa hàng bán bánh mì tươi -> relative clause without that/which is
entries.context: I go every morning to this is the shop sell fresh bread near my house.

entries.vietlish: i need a friend can help me move
entries.natural: I need a friend who can help me move
entries.sourcePattern: tôi cần một người bạn có thể giúp tôi dọn nhà -> relative clause without who
entries.context: I am moving this Saturday and i need a friend can help me move.

entries.vietlish: he is a person know everything
entries.natural: he is a person who knows everything
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy là người biết tất cả -> relative clause without who, verb uninflected
entries.context: Ask him anything about computers, he is a person know everything.

entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy sinh năm 1998 -> passive was born reduced to bare past participle
entries.context: She is 27 years old this year. She born in 1998.

entries.sourcePattern: cái xe màu đỏ to -> color before size; English places size before color
entries.context: My boss drives the red big car that is always parked outside.

entries.sourcePattern: tấm đĩa nhỏ tròn -> shape before size; English places size before shape
entries.context: Please use a round small plate for the appetizers.

entries.sourcePattern: cái áo trắng mới -> color before age; English places age/recency before color
entries.context: He wore a white new shirt to the job interview.

entries.sourcePattern: tòa nhà lớn cũ -> age before size; English places size before age
entries.context: The office is inside the old big building near the station.

entries.sourcePattern: con chim nhỏ màu xanh -> color before size; English places size before color
entries.context: I saw a blue little bird sitting on my windowsill this morning.

entries.sourcePattern: cái váy dài đẹp -> length before opinion; English places opinion before length
entries.context: She wore a long beautiful dress to the wedding last Saturday.

entries.sourcePattern: cái nhẫn đắt tiền đẹp -> value before opinion; English places opinion first
entries.context: He gave her an expensive beautiful ring for their anniversary.

entries.vietlish: every day i exercise at morning
entries.sourcePattern: mỗi ngày tôi tập thể dục vào buổi sáng -> at morning instead of in the morning; temporal adverb misplaced
entries.context: I try to stay healthy so every day i exercise at morning.

entries.vietlish: he study hard but still fail exam
entries.natural: he studied hard but still failed the exam
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy học chăm nhưng vẫn thi rớt -> bare verbs without tense inflection; article dropped
entries.context: I feel so bad for him. He study hard but still fail exam.

entries.sourcePattern: ngày mai bạn có rảnh không -> adverb at start, copula dropped in yes/no question
entries.context: I want to invite you to dinner. Tomorrow you have free?

entries.vietlish: he always is late for work
entries.natural: he is always late for work
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy luôn luôn đến muộn -> frequency adverb placed after be rather than before main verb
entries.context: The manager is frustrated because he always is late for work.

entries.natural: she is a student at university
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy là sinh viên đại học -> copula là dropped; pronoun subject with omitted is
entries.context: She a student at university and she works part-time at a café.

entries.natural: could I have the bill, please
entries.sourcePattern: đưa tôi tờ hóa đơn -> imperative without softening; too direct for a restaurant setting
entries.context: The learner called the server over and said: give me the bill.

entries.natural: I would like that one, please
entries.sourcePattern: lấy cho tôi cái đó -> direct command; would like softens the request in a service setting
entries.context: At the bakery display she pointed and said: give me that one.

entries.natural: I would like this one, please
entries.sourcePattern: tôi muốn cái này -> want is too blunt in a service setting; would like is more polite
entries.context: At the coffee shop he pointed to the menu and said: i want this.

entries.natural: please do not bother wrapping it
entries.sourcePattern: không cần đóng gói -> blunt negative command; too terse for a service interaction
entries.context: After buying the gift she told the shopkeeper: no need to pack, I will carry it like this.

entries.vietlish: i am busy now talk later
entries.natural: I am currently unavailable, may I call you back
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đang bận, nói chuyện sau -> serial blunt statement; missing modal and politeness marker
entries.context: When her boss called during the meeting she replied: i am busy now talk later.

entries.natural: I apologize for the delayed response
entries.sourcePattern: xin lỗi trả lời muộn -> casual bare apology phrase; inadequate register for professional email
entries.context: She started her work email with: sorry i late reply, I was traveling all week.

entries.natural: could you clarify what you mean
entries.sourcePattern: bạn ý muốn nói gì -> no softening; sounds confrontational in a professional context
entries.context: During the meeting he interrupted and asked: what you mean by that chart?

entries.natural: could you please speak a little more slowly
entries.sourcePattern: bạn có thể nói lại chậm hơn -> adjective slow instead of adverb slowly; can instead of could
entries.context: She told the professor: can you repeat more slow? I did not catch that.

entries.natural: I was wondering if you might be available
entries.sourcePattern: bạn có rảnh không -> overly direct yes/no question used in a formal email context
entries.context: He opened his email to his director with: are you free for a meeting tomorrow?

entries.natural: I would respectfully like to offer a different perspective
entries.sourcePattern: tôi nghĩ ý kiến của bạn sai -> too blunt and direct for a professional meeting
entries.context: In the presentation she said: i think your idea wrong and we should use a different method.

entries.natural: there are several areas in this report that need revision
entries.sourcePattern: báo cáo này có nhiều lỗi -> blunt evaluation; no diplomatic framing for written feedback
entries.context: The manager wrote in the feedback: this report has many mistakes, please redo.

entries.vietlish: doctor i feel not good here
entries.natural: Doctor, I have been experiencing some discomfort in this area
entries.sourcePattern: bác sĩ ơi tôi cảm thấy không khỏe ở đây -> missing body reference; too casual register for medical
entries.context: She pointed to her chest and said: doctor i feel not good here for the past week.

entries.vietlish: i do not understand please explain again
entries.natural: I am sorry, I am not quite following; could you please elaborate
entries.sourcePattern: tôi không hiểu, giải thích lại đi -> blunt chain of directives; no softening markers
entries.context: After the lecture he raised his hand: i do not understand please explain again.

entries.natural: it is a pleasure to meet you
entries.sourcePattern: rất vui được gặp bạn -> adjective-first opening; formal intro requires it is a pleasure to meet you
entries.context: At the networking event she shook hands and said: very happy to meet you.

entries.natural: may I ask you a question
entries.sourcePattern: hỏi bạn một câu -> bare infinitive opener; subject and modal both dropped
entries.context: He walked up to the speaker after the talk and said: ask you a question about the data.

entries.natural: please allow me to introduce myself
entries.sourcePattern: chị ơi cho em tự giới thiệu -> honorific calque; formal self-introduction phrasing
entries.context: She approached the senior colleague saying: older sister let me introduce, I am the new intern.

entries.sourcePattern: bạn trông rất trẻ -> commenting on age is too personal in many Western professional settings
entries.context: At the first meeting she said to the client: you look very young to be a manager.

entries.vietlish: your english is very good for a vietnamese person
entries.sourcePattern: tiếng Anh bạn giỏi lắm với một người Việt Nam -> ethnic qualifier is offensive in this context
entries.context: After the presentation he told the speaker: your english is very good for a vietnamese person.

entries.natural: I sent you an email yesterday; please check when you have a chance
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đã gửi email cho bạn hôm qua -> wrong tense; missing politeness closer for professional email
entries.context: She started her follow-up message with: i send you email yesterday about the contract.

entries.natural: could you please send me this document
entries.sourcePattern: hỗ trợ tôi tài liệu này -> hỗ trợ (support) overextended to mean provide/send
entries.context: She emailed the colleague: please support me this document for tomorrow's meeting.

entries.sourcePattern: ăn thuốc viên -> ăn (eat) is used for consuming medicine including pills in Vietnamese
entries.context: I have a headache so I need to eat a pill before the meeting.

entries.sourcePattern: rửa răng -> rửa (wash) is used; brush is the natural English collocate for teeth
entries.context: Remember to wash teeth before you go to bed tonight.

entries.sourcePattern: gội đầu -> gội is the specific verb for washing hair; learner drops possessive
entries.context: I need to wash hair tonight before the early meeting tomorrow.

entries.sourcePattern: cắt tóc -> cut hair is a direct translation; English uses get a haircut for the service
entries.context: I look messy, I need to cut hair this weekend.

entries.sourcePattern: nấu cơm -> nấu covers all cooking methods; boil is too literal for cooking rice in a pot
entries.context: I am going to boil rice for dinner tonight.

entries.sourcePattern: theo dõi sức khỏe -> follow up needs on as object marker; Vietnamese has no equivalent preposition
entries.context: I should go back to the doctor to follow up my health next month.

entries.sourcePattern: đi vệ sinh / đi toilet -> go to toilet is a direct calque; English prefers use the restroom in formal settings
entries.context: Excuse me for a moment, I need to go to toilet.

entries.sourcePattern: vết thương tốt hơn -> better for general improvement; healing is the specific collocate for wounds
entries.context: The wound is better but I will keep it bandaged for another day.

entries.sourcePattern: mắt không tốt -> not good used for eyesight; English collocates with poor eyesight
entries.context: I need to see an eye doctor because my eyes are not good lately.

entries.sourcePattern: tiết kiệm tiền ở ngân hàng -> in bank instead of at the bank; Vietnamese ở maps to both in/at
entries.context: I save money in bank every month for a future apartment.

entries.sourcePattern: khăng khăng trả tiền -> insist takes on + gerund, not to-infinitive
entries.context: He always insist to pay the bill when we go out for dinner.

entries.sourcePattern: thành công trong việc qua bài thi -> succeed takes in + gerund, not to-infinitive
entries.context: After months of study she finally succeed to pass the test.

entries.sourcePattern: xin lỗi vì đến muộn -> apologize takes for + gerund, not to-infinitive
entries.context: She called her boss to apologize to be late for the morning meeting.

entries.vietlish: blame someone to make a mistake
entries.natural: blame someone for making a mistake
entries.sourcePattern: đổ lỗi vì ai đó sai -> blame takes for + gerund, not to-infinitive
entries.context: It is unfair to blame someone to make a mistake on their first day.

entries.sourcePattern: dựa vào người khác -> rely on; Vietnamese dựa vào uses a direction word that maps to to
entries.context: You should not rely to others too much if you want to grow.

entries.sourcePattern: trả lời email của tôi -> respond to; Vietnamese trả lời does not require a preposition direction
entries.context: I have been waiting three days but he did not respond on my email.

entries.sourcePattern: góp phần giải quyết vấn đề -> contribute to + gerund, not to-infinitive
entries.context: Everyone should contribute to solve the problem together.

entries.sourcePattern: chúc mừng ai đó -> congratulate takes object + on, not to
entries.context: I want to congratulate to someone who helped us succeed.

entries.sourcePattern: cung cấp cho học sinh -> provide + object + with, not provide to
entries.context: The school will provide to the students new textbooks next term.

entries.sourcePattern: phê duyệt kế hoạch -> approve is transitive; to is incorrectly added
entries.context: The manager will approve to the plan after reviewing the budget.

entries.sourcePattern: vay tiền ngân hàng -> borrow from; Vietnamese vay does not require a direction preposition
entries.context: I need to borrow money to the bank for my new business.

entries.sourcePattern: thuê xe -> thuê = both rent/hire; rent out adds wrong direction (rent out means to be the lessor)
entries.context: We should rent out a car for the road trip next weekend.

entries.sourcePattern: trả lại tiền thối -> give back implies returning something borrowed; change is simply owed
entries.context: I paid with a large bill, please give back my change.

entries.sourcePattern: quay lại chủ đề -> return already means come back; back is a redundant calque of quay lại
entries.context: We have been talking about many things, let us return back to the topic.

entries.sourcePattern: mở rộng kiến thức -> expand is a false collocate; broaden/widen/deepen are the natural English verbs
entries.context: I read books every day to expand my knowledge.

entries.sourcePattern: tăng vốn từ vựng -> increase is used for numbers; build up / expand / enrich is natural for vocabulary
entries.context: I use flashcards every day to increase my vocabulary.

entries.sourcePattern: bấm chụp ảnh -> bấm (press) the button to take a photo; learners carry press into English
entries.context: Stand still while I press a photo of you in front of the waterfall.

entries.sourcePattern: chụp ảnh -> chụp = take/press; have a photo sounds like possessing rather than taking
entries.context: Let us have a photo together before you leave.

entries.sourcePattern: làm ảnh -> làm is an all-purpose do/make verb; do a photo is unnatural in English
entries.context: Can you do a photo of me and my friends?

entries.sourcePattern: gõ cửa -> Vietnamese gõ cửa takes no preposition; English uses knock on
entries.context: Before entering any room you should always knock the door first.

entries.sourcePattern: cập nhật kiến thức -> upgrade suggests a version level change; update is natural for knowledge refreshing
entries.context: I attend seminars every month to upgrade my knowledge of the industry.

entries.vietlish: make a loan from the bank
entries.natural: take out a loan from the bank
entries.sourcePattern: vay vốn ngân hàng -> make a loan is unnatural; take out a loan is the English collocation
entries.context: She needs to make a loan from the bank to start her business.

entries.sourcePattern: bị bệnh / bị ốm -> fall sick is literal calque; get sick is more common in everyday English
entries.context: I think I will fall sick if I keep working without sleeping.

entries.sourcePattern: mất mặt -> face in this idiom does not take an article or possessive
entries.context: I do not want to lose my face in front of my colleagues.

entries.sourcePattern: học ở nước ngoài -> at abroad is ungrammatical; abroad functions as an adverb with no preposition
entries.context: My dream is to study at abroad for at least one year.

entries.sourcePattern: đạt được thỏa thuận cùng nhau -> together is redundant; reach an agreement already implies joint action
entries.context: Both teams worked hard to reach an agreement together by the deadline.

entries.sourcePattern: giải quyết hồ sơ visa -> solve is overused from giải quyết; sort out is natural for paperwork issues
entries.context: I need more time to solve my visa application before traveling to Europe.

entries.sourcePattern: giải quyết mâu thuẫn -> solve is for puzzles/equations; resolve is natural for interpersonal conflicts
entries.context: The teacher stepped in to solve the classroom conflict between two students.

entries.sourcePattern: giải quyết máy in hỏng -> solve is for abstract problems; fix is for physical devices
entries.context: Can someone help me solve the broken printer in the office?

entries.sourcePattern: giải quyết rào cản ngôn ngữ -> overcome is the natural English verb for challenges and barriers
entries.context: Working abroad helped her solve the language barrier over time.

entries.vietlish: i will reflect this issue to manager
entries.natural: I will report this issue to the manager
entries.sourcePattern: phản ánh vấn đề -> phản ánh = reflect; in English reflect is for surfaces/thought, not reporting
entries.context: Do not worry, i will reflect this issue to manager in the morning meeting.

entries.vietlish: please reflect the problem to customer service
entries.natural: please report the problem to customer service
entries.sourcePattern: phản ánh vấn đề -> phản ánh overextended to mean report/escalate
entries.context: If you are not satisfied, please reflect the problem to customer service.

entries.vietlish: she reflected her concerns to the board
entries.natural: she conveyed her concerns to the board
entries.sourcePattern: phản ánh mối lo ngại -> reflect is for surfaces and thought; convey/communicate is natural here
entries.context: She reflected her concerns to the board about the budget cuts.

entries.vietlish: i need to reflect this feedback to the team
entries.natural: I need to pass on this feedback to the team
entries.sourcePattern: phản ánh ý kiến -> reflect as a relay verb; pass on/share is natural in English
entries.context: Thank you for the comments, i need to reflect this feedback to the team.

entries.vietlish: he reflected his salary issue to HR
entries.natural: he raised his salary issue with HR
entries.sourcePattern: phản ánh vấn đề lương -> reflect instead of raise/bring up; HR interaction context
entries.context: He reflected his salary issue to HR after the annual review.

entries.vietlish: i want to remember you about the meeting
entries.natural: I want to remind you about the meeting
entries.sourcePattern: nhắc bạn -> nhắc = remind; learner uses remember (nhớ) because both share a memory-related root
entries.context: Before you leave, i want to remember you about the meeting at three o'clock.

entries.vietlish: please remember me to buy the tickets
entries.natural: please remind me to buy the tickets
entries.sourcePattern: nhắc tôi -> nhắc = remind, but learners conflate with nhớ (remember)
entries.context: When you see me tomorrow, please remember me to buy the tickets.

entries.vietlish: she remembered me to return the key
entries.natural: she reminded me to return the key
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy nhắc tôi -> nhắc overloaded as remember due to shared memory domain
entries.context: Before I left, she remembered me to return the key to the front desk.

entries.vietlish: can you remember me when it is time to leave
entries.natural: can you remind me when it is time to leave
entries.sourcePattern: nhắc tôi khi đến giờ -> nhắc = remind, not remember
entries.context: I tend to lose track of time, can you remember me when it is time to leave?

entries.vietlish: can you borrow me your pen
entries.natural: can you lend me your pen
entries.sourcePattern: cho tôi mượn cái bút -> mượn = borrow, but cho mượn = lend; Vietnamese learners use borrow for both directions
entries.context: I forgot mine today, can you borrow me your pen for a moment?

entries.vietlish: i will borrow you the money
entries.natural: I will lend you the money
entries.sourcePattern: tôi sẽ cho bạn mượn tiền -> cho mượn = lend; learner uses borrow for the lending direction
entries.context: Do not worry about the deposit, i will borrow you the money.

entries.vietlish: she borrowed him fifty dollars to cover the bill
entries.natural: she lent him fifty dollars to cover the bill
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy cho anh ấy mượn năm mươi đô -> borrow used for the lend direction
entries.context: He forgot his wallet so she borrowed him fifty dollars to cover the bill.

entries.vietlish: the library borrow books to students for free
entries.natural: the library lends books to students for free
entries.sourcePattern: thư viện cho học sinh mượn sách -> lend/borrow confusion; borrow used for the provider direction
entries.context: This is a great service: the library borrow books to students for free.

entries.vietlish: she said me to wait outside
entries.natural: she told me to wait outside
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy nói với tôi -> nói với = say to; English say does not take an indirect object this way
entries.context: I was not sure why, but she said me to wait outside the conference room.

entries.sourcePattern: tôi nói với anh ấy sự thật -> nói (say) used where tell is required with a person as indirect object
entries.context: I decided to be honest and i said him the truth about what happened.

entries.vietlish: teacher said us to open the book
entries.natural: the teacher told us to open the book
entries.sourcePattern: thầy cô nói chúng tôi mở sách -> say used with indirect object; English requires tell here
entries.context: Teacher said us to open the book to chapter five.

entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy nói với tôi bí mật của anh ấy -> nói used where tell is required with personal object
entries.context: I feel honored that he said me his secret last night.

entries.vietlish: we need to discuss about the project
entries.natural: we need to discuss the project
entries.sourcePattern: thảo luận về dự án -> thảo luận về requires về (about); English discuss is already transitive
entries.context: We need to discuss about the project before sending the proposal.

entries.vietlish: let us discuss about your proposal
entries.sourcePattern: thảo luận về đề xuất -> about is redundant after discuss; direct object is sufficient
entries.context: I read through your document. Let us discuss about your proposal on Thursday.

entries.vietlish: they discussed about the new policy
entries.sourcePattern: họ thảo luận về chính sách mới -> about is inserted from Vietnamese về but is redundant in English
entries.context: They discussed about the new policy for over two hours during the retreat.

entries.sourcePattern: luyện tập tiếng Anh -> luyện tập = exercise/practice; in English exercise is for physical activity
entries.context: I set aside one hour to i exercise english every day after work.

entries.sourcePattern: luyện kỹ năng nói -> exercise carries over for skill practice; English practice is the collocate
entries.context: Every morning she exercises her speaking skill by reading news aloud.

entries.sourcePattern: luyện ngữ pháp -> exercise overextended from luyện for physical sense; practice is the correct collocate
entries.context: Your writing will improve if you exercise your grammar more each week.

entries.sourcePattern: tham dự hội nghị -> tham dự = attend; participate is intransitive and needs in; attend takes a direct object
entries.context: My company is sending me overseas. I will participate the conference next month.

entries.vietlish: she participated our class without registering
entries.natural: she attended our class without registering
entries.sourcePattern: tham gia lớp học -> participate needs in; attend takes a direct object
entries.context: She participated our class without registering and sat in the back row.

entries.vietlish: you should participate the seminar this weekend
entries.natural: you should attend the seminar this weekend
entries.sourcePattern: tham dự hội thảo -> participate is intransitive; attend is the correct transitive verb
entries.context: You should participate the seminar this weekend to network with experts.

entries.vietlish: can you explain me how to do it
entries.natural: can you explain to me how to do it
entries.sourcePattern: giải thích cho tôi -> giải thích cho requires indirect object marker; English explain needs to before person
entries.context: This is my first time using this software. Can you explain me how to do it?

entries.natural: please explain the rules to me
entries.sourcePattern: giải thích cho tôi các quy tắc -> explain does not take a double object without to
entries.context: Before we start the game, please explain me the rules.

entries.vietlish: i need to separate with my old habit
entries.natural: I need to break my old habit
entries.sourcePattern: tách rời thói quen cũ -> tách rời = separate; English uses break a habit as the fixed idiom
entries.context: I need to separate with my old habit of staying up too late.

entries.sourcePattern: đi đến thỏa thuận -> learners insert to from đi đến (go to/reach); reach agreement is direct in English
entries.context: After a long negotiation, they reached to an agreement on the price.

entries.vietlish: i want to evaluate my english level
entries.natural: I want to assess my English level
entries.sourcePattern: đánh giá trình độ tiếng Anh -> evaluate is formal/academic; assess is more natural for personal language level
entries.context: Before starting the course, i want to evaluate my english level.

entries.sourcePattern: chia thông tin đều nhau -> chia = divide/share; divide implies splitting into pieces rather than distributing
entries.context: We all worked on this research so please divide the information equally.

entries.vietlish: i want to transfer to a bigger office
entries.natural: I want to move to a bigger office
entries.sourcePattern: chuyển đến văn phòng lớn hơn -> chuyển = transfer/move; transfer implies an organizational process
entries.context: My current workspace is too small. I want to transfer to a bigger office.

entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy được thăng chức lên giám đốc -> promoted without was; passive requires the auxiliary
entries.context: After five years in the company she promoted to director last quarter.

entries.vietlish: he resigned from his job voluntarily
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy tự nguyện từ chức -> tự nguyện = voluntarily; resign already implies a voluntary act
entries.context: He was not fired. He resigned from his job voluntarily to start his own company.

entries.vietlish: i waiting for you for one hour
entries.natural: I have been waiting for you for an hour
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đợi bạn một tiếng đồng hồ -> progressive aspect without auxiliary; perfect aspect lost
entries.context: Where have you been? I waiting for you for one hour already.

entries.natural: I have been waiting here since morning
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đợi ở đây từ sáng -> progressive without auxiliary; present perfect continuous needed
entries.context: I waiting here since morning and nobody told me the office was closed.

entries.vietlish: she studying english for two years
entries.natural: she has been studying English for two years
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy học tiếng Anh hai năm -> duration with present reference needs present perfect continuous
entries.context: She has improved a lot. She studying english for two years now.

entries.sourcePattern: họ đang nói chuyện -> đang marks ongoing aspect; auxiliary are omitted in the calque
entries.context: Do not disturb them. They talking right now in the meeting room.

entries.vietlish: we planning a trip next month
entries.natural: we are planning a trip next month
entries.sourcePattern: chúng tôi đang lên kế hoạch -> đang marks ongoing; auxiliary are omitted
entries.context: We planning a trip next month to the central highlands.

entries.sourcePattern: tôi biết câu trả lời -> stative verb know cannot take progressive; Vietnamese có thể adds đang freely
entries.context: Do not call on anyone else, i knowing the answer to this question.

entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy tin vào chúa -> stative believe used in progressive; Vietnamese đang applies freely to beliefs
entries.context: She does not join us for those activities because she believing in god.

entries.sourcePattern: tôi hiểu rồi -> stative understand used in progressive form; rồi (now/already) triggers -ing
entries.context: Oh, i understanding now what you were trying to explain.

entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy muốn điện thoại mới -> stative want used in progressive; Vietnamese muốn freely takes đang
entries.context: He is saving money because he wanting a new phone for his birthday.

entries.sourcePattern: chúng tôi cần thêm thời gian -> stative need placed in progressive incorrectly
entries.context: Please do not rush us, we are needing more time to finish this project.

entries.vietlish: i did not went to school yesterday
entries.natural: I did not go to school yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đã không đi học hôm qua -> did not + past form; learner uses past tense after did not
entries.context: I was not feeling well so i did not went to school yesterday.

entries.vietlish: she did not came to work
entries.natural: she did not come to work
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy không đến làm -> did not + past form; came retained after auxiliary
entries.context: She did not came to work and did not send any message to explain.

entries.vietlish: he did not told me the truth
entries.natural: he did not tell me the truth
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy không nói thật -> did not + past form; told retained after auxiliary
entries.context: I found out later that he did not told me the truth about his background.

entries.vietlish: i did not saw that movie
entries.natural: I did not see that movie
entries.sourcePattern: tôi chưa xem bộ phim đó -> did not + past form; saw retained after auxiliary
entries.context: I did not saw that movie but everyone is telling me to watch it.

entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy không nấu ăn tối -> did not + past form; made retained after auxiliary
entries.context: We had to order food because she did not made dinner that evening.

entries.vietlish: he did not understood the question
entries.natural: he did not understand the question
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy không hiểu câu hỏi -> did not + past form; understood retained
entries.context: He answered incorrectly because he did not understood the question.

entries.vietlish: they did not finished the project
entries.natural: they did not finish the project
entries.sourcePattern: họ không hoàn thành dự án -> did not + past form; finished retained
entries.context: The deadline passed but they did not finished the project on time.

entries.vietlish: i am here for two hours already
entries.natural: I have been here for two hours
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đang ở đây hai tiếng rồi -> present simple/continuous instead of present perfect continuous
entries.context: Can we order soon? I am here for two hours already and I am hungry.

entries.vietlish: i study at this school for three years
entries.natural: I have studied at this school for three years
entries.sourcePattern: tôi học ở trường này ba năm -> simple present instead of present perfect for ongoing duration
entries.context: I know the campus well because i study at this school for three years.

entries.vietlish: she work at this company since 2019
entries.natural: she has worked at this company since 2019
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy làm việc ở công ty này từ 2019 -> simple present instead of present perfect
entries.context: She knows everyone here because she work at this company since 2019.

entries.vietlish: they are friends since they were children
entries.natural: they have been friends since they were children
entries.sourcePattern: họ là bạn bè từ khi còn nhỏ -> present simple instead of present perfect for long-standing state
entries.context: They are very close. They are friends since they were children.

entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy chưa ăn -> present perfect needed for not-yet states; did not eat treats it as completed past
entries.context: He is hungry because he did not eat yet today.

entries.sourcePattern: tôi vừa xong bài tập -> vừa (just) triggers present perfect in English; simple past or perfect needed
entries.context: You can call me now, i just finish my homework a few minutes ago.

entries.vietlish: she just arrive to the meeting
entries.natural: she has just arrived at the meeting
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy vừa đến cuộc họp -> just triggers present perfect; arrive at not arrive to
entries.context: Wait for her, she just arrive to the meeting and needs a moment.

entries.sourcePattern: tôi cần một lời khuyên -> advice is uncountable in English; an advice is ungrammatical
entries.context: I am in a difficult situation. I need an advice from someone I trust.

entries.vietlish: can you give me an information
entries.natural: can you give me some information
entries.sourcePattern: có thể cho tôi một thông tin -> information is uncountable; an information is ungrammatical
entries.context: I am new to this area. Can you give me an information about nearby clinics?

entries.vietlish: i heard many noises last night
entries.natural: I heard a lot of noise last night
entries.sourcePattern: tôi nghe nhiều tiếng ồn tối qua -> noise is uncountable in this sense; noises implies distinct sounds
entries.context: I could not sleep well because i heard many noises last night.

entries.vietlish: i made a research on this topic
entries.natural: I did some research on this topic
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đã nghiên cứu về chủ đề này -> research is uncountable; make a research is ungrammatical
entries.context: Before the meeting I made a research on this topic to be prepared.

entries.vietlish: the furnitures in this room are old
entries.natural: the furniture in this room is old
entries.sourcePattern: đồ đạc trong phòng này cũ -> đồ đạc treated as countable; furniture is uncountable in English
entries.context: We should renovate because the furnitures in this room are old and worn out.

entries.vietlish: we need more equipments for the lab
entries.natural: we need more equipment for the lab
entries.sourcePattern: chúng ta cần thêm thiết bị cho phòng thí nghiệm -> equipment is uncountable; equipments is ungrammatical
entries.context: We need funding because we need more equipments for the lab this semester.

entries.vietlish: i want to be doctor when i grow up
entries.natural: I want to be a doctor when I grow up
entries.sourcePattern: tôi muốn làm bác sĩ -> Vietnamese profession nouns need no article; English requires indefinite article
entries.context: Since I was young I always said i want to be doctor when i grow up.

entries.vietlish: he is best student in the class
entries.natural: he is the best student in the class
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy là học sinh giỏi nhất lớp -> superlative requires the; Vietnamese does not use an article
entries.context: Everyone knows him because he is best student in the class.

entries.natural: I use the internet every day
entries.sourcePattern: tôi dùng mạng internet mỗi ngày -> internet requires the in English; Vietnamese has no article system
entries.context: I depend on technology. I use internet every day for work and entertainment.

entries.vietlish: i bought new car last month
entries.natural: I bought a new car last month
entries.sourcePattern: tôi mua xe mới tháng trước -> Vietnamese nouns need no article; English requires indefinite article
entries.context: I finally saved enough money. I bought new car last month.

entries.natural: they took a taxi to the airport
entries.sourcePattern: họ đi taxi ra sân bay -> both articles missing; Vietnamese needs no articles
entries.context: They did not drive themselves. They took taxi to airport early in the morning.
